certified_by: builder, full suite run locally against PostgreSQL 17.11 with DATABASE_URL set; the six ids below were emitted by scripts/pg_gate.py --emit-baseline from that run's captured output, not transcribed.
note: failing_tests holds DISTINCT test ids, which is why its length is 6 while failures+errors is 7: orders.tests.OrderIndexSchemaTests.test_payment_provider_references_stay_constraint_covered uses subTest over two columns and emits two failure headers for one test. This file is hand-maintained and is never written by scripts/pg_gate.py -- a self-updating baseline records whatever the last run did, which is the defect the gate exists to catch. When a fix lands, delete that entry in the same commit; pg_gate.py reports an entry that stopped failing as a warning and stays green so the fix is not punished. To re-certify after an intended change, run scripts/pg_gate.py --emit-baseline and review the diff by hand.
